claim: A single dynamic next-generation attack score outperforms static spectral baselines.
binding_failure: Dynamic score was worse on MAE, AUC, Brier, robustness, and dependency ablation.
next_action: Retire as a scalar replacement. Retain dynamic layers as features or state variables.

claim: A training-selected temporal scalar outperforms pre-response non-backtracking.
binding_failure: Training selected propagator growth, which increased held-out MAE by 20.5 percent.
next_action: Do not use one training-selected scalar for both outbreak occurrence and final size.

claim: Reflected multi-resource overload index Omega_A transfers across scale and profile shape.
evidence_class: analytic construct plus model-conditioned preregistered confirmatory
status: not supported under fixed rule; strong provisional signal
primary_metric: Omega AUC 0.992; AUC delta 0.058; Brier improvement 0.506
binding_failure: AUC superiority was below 0.08 and only three of five robustness blocks met the full block rule.
next_action: Calibrate resource work and capacities from a real control plane, then run prospective external validation.

claim: A fixed two-stage model improves held-out mean final compromise prediction across independent blocks.
status: not supported under fixed rule; mixed positive evidence
primary_metric: Pooled MAE improvement 0.188; 95 percent interval 0.088 to 0.292
binding_failure: Only one block exceeded 15 percent improvement and Brier noninferiority held in only one block.
next_action: Keep phase separation, replace the initiation calibrator, and validate on measured attack traces.
